window.onload = function () { // 插入初始化的主题 const themeLink = document.createElement('link') themeLink.rel = 'stylesheet' themeLink.id = 'theme-link' const isDarkTheme = localStorage.theme === 'dark' || ((!localStorage.theme || localStorage.theme === 'system') && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) themeLink.href = `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}/themes/aura-${isDarkTheme ? 'dark' : 'light'}-blue/theme.css` document.head.appendChild(themeLink) }
